name: Initial Stock for WooCommerce
author: Pedro Miguel Martins

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/initial-stock-for-woocommerce or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Edit any product or variation → Inventory tab → fill in the Initial Stock fields.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify my stock automatically?

No. The plugin only stores the initial values you manually enter. It does not sync, calculate, or change stock levels.

Are the Initial Stock fields required?

No. If left empty, nothing happens—WooCommerce behaves as normal.

Does it support product variations?

Yes. Each variation gets its own Initial Stock Quantity and Initial Stock Date.

Can I export these values?

Yes, most export/import plugins will detect the custom meta fields stored by this plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added Initial Stock Quantity and Date fields to products and variations.
  • Manual entry only — no automated stock manipulation.
  • Lightweight and fully compatible with WooCommerce stock management.
sections.description:
Save and track a product’s initial stock quantity and initial stock date in WooCommerce.

English

Initial Stock for WooCommerce adds a simple but powerful inventory management feature to WooCommerce: the ability to record and store the initial stock quantity and the initial stock date for each product and product variation.

This is especially useful for:

  • Merchants who want to keep a historical reference for stock audits
  • Shops that need traceability between the first stock entry and current stock
  • Warehouse or logistics workflows
  • Reporting, forecasting, or integration with external systems

The plugin adds two fields to every product and variation:

  • Initial Stock Quantity
  • Initial Stock Date

Both fields are manually filled by the user. If left empty, WooCommerce continues to function normally—the plugin does not override or modify stock levels.

Key Features

  • ✔️ Store initial stock quantity and date per product
  • ✔️ Full support for product variations
  • ✔️ Clean, minimal UI integrated into WooCommerce stock settings
  • ✔️ Does not interfere with WooCommerce’s internal stock management
  • ✔️ Useful for audits, reporting, forecasting, and inventory control

No automation is applied to these values: the merchant decides when and how to record the initial stock information.

PRO Version

  • Initial Stock for WooCommerce PRO: extends the core idea of simply storing an initial stock value into a professional-grade stock management, history, and interoperability solution, designed for stores with real operational and auditing needs. In addition to manual entry per product and variation, the PRO version enables bulk import of initial stock via CSV (using product IDs), export of complete stock history, and full temporal traceability between the initial stock and all subsequent changes. These capabilities allow seamless integration with reporting, accounting, logistics, and external systems, making it an ideal tool for medium to large stores, warehouse teams, and professional workflows that require more than WooCommerce’s current stock value. Download.

Português (PT-PT)

O Initial Stock for WooCommerce adiciona ao WooCommerce a capacidade de registar e guardar a quantidade inicial de stock e a data de stock inicial de cada produto e variação.

É particularmente útil para:

  • Lojas que precisam de manter um registo histórico para auditorias
  • Fluxos de logística que exigem rastreabilidade entre o stock inicial e o stock atual
  • Planeamento e previsões de inventário
  • Integrações com sistemas externos

O plugin adiciona dois campos a cada produto e variação:

  • Quantidade Inicial de Stock
  • Data Inicial de Stock

Ambos os campos são preenchidos manualmente pelo utilizador. Se ficarem vazios, o WooCommerce continua a funcionar normalmente — o plugin não altera nem controla os níveis de stock.

Funcionalidades Principais

  • ✔️ Registo da quantidade e data de stock inicial por produto
  • ✔️ Compatível com variações de produto
  • ✔️ Interface simples integrada no painel de stock do WooCommerce
  • ✔️ Não interfere com a gestão de stock do WooCommerce
  • ✔️ Útil para auditorias, relatórios e controlo de inventário

O plugin não automatiza estes valores: cabe ao utilizador decidir quando registar a informação de stock inicial.

Versão PRO

  • Initial Stock for WooCommerce PRO: Expande o conceito base de simples registo de stock inicial para uma solução profissional de gestão, histórico e interoperabilidade de stock, pensada para lojas com necessidades reais de controlo e auditoria. Para além do registo manual por produto e variação, a versão PRO permite importar stocks iniciais em massa via CSV (por ID de produto), exportar o histórico completo de stock, manter rastreabilidade temporal entre o stock inicial e as alterações subsequentes, e integrar esses dados em processos de reporting, contabilidade, logística ou sistemas externos. É uma ferramenta orientada a eficiência operacional, consistência de dados e escalabilidade, ideal para lojas médias/grandes, equipas de armazém e workflows profissionais que exigem mais do que o stock “atual” do WooCommerce. Descarregar.

Legal Notice

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic. “WooCommerce” is a trademark of Automattic Inc.
